name: 合规话术·English（集运丢件）
opening: Hello, sorry to bother you. This is customer service from XX Consolidation Warehouse. I’m calling about an issue with one of your parcels. Will you have one minute?
closing: Great. I will text you the ticket number shortly. Quote it to official customer service and they can assist you. Please submit the screenshot when you can; we will review immediately upon receipt. Thank you for your understanding. Goodbye.
hotwords: Pinduoduo,Taobao,JD,tracking number,ticket,insured value,claim,official customer service window,screenshot,official website

steps_json.ref:
Hello, sorry to bother you. This is customer service from XX Consolidation Warehouse. I’m calling about an issue with one of your parcels. Will you have one minute?
If the customer doubts you are genuine and refuses to verify → I totally understand your concerns—there are a lot of scams these days. You can hang up now and call our official hotline on our website. Enter your phone number and you’ll find this loss report and my staff ID. You can also verify on another line while I stay on, no problem.
If the customer says they are busy right now and asks to call later → No problem, I won’t disturb you. What time would be convenient for a call back? I will call you again on time. You can also contact our official customer service later and quote your phone number to pull up this ticket.
Note: handle everything through official channels only—never share personal contact details or ask for verification codes or passwords.

We’re very sorry—this was an operational error during packing at our warehouse. We’re still reviewing whether it was mis-sorted or missed scanning, but the parcel is confirmed missing after a full warehouse check. This is entirely our fault. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
If the customer says the item is urgent and is worried about the delay → I completely understand how frustrating it is when something you need urgently doesn’t arrive. We’re truly sorry. We will put your claim on our fast-track channel to process payment as quickly as possible, so you can reorder immediately. If you send an urgent parcel later, we will also prioritize it for you.
If the customer asks which parcel it is or wants the tracking number → I can text you the full tracking number shortly; the last four digits are XXXX. The shipping label only shows your name, phone number and delivery address—not the contents inside. That’s why we need to verify with you. You can think if you’ve recently ordered anything shipped to our warehouse that you haven’t received yet.
If the customer asks how the parcel got lost and wants an explanation → At this stage our initial assessment is that it was mis-sorted during processing. The exact cause is still under internal review. Whatever the reason, the fault is ours. We will compensate you according to our rules and will make internal improvements to prevent this happening again.
Note: the cause of loss follows the internal investigation—only share the preliminary assessment and never invent details.

To help verify your parcel, could you find the matching undelivered order on the shopping platform? And which platform was it ordered from—Pinduoduo, Taobao or JD?
If the customer finds it too much trouble to look for the order screenshot → I know this extra step feels like a hassle, and I’m sorry. Order screenshots are the only valid proof for payment calculation. Without them we can’t go through finance approval, and we also want to make sure the amount is fair to you. If you can’t find the order, you can contact the shopping platform to restore your order history—it’s quick.
If the customer is worried about privacy and doesn’t want to send a screenshot → I totally understand your privacy concerns, and you can rest assured. All documents you submit will only be used for this one claim review, then filed away. They will never be used for any other purpose, and we comply with privacy protection regulations. You can also blur out your personal info on the screenshot—we just need to see the item name and actual amount paid.
If the customer has several parcels and doesn’t know which one it is → It’s definitely hard to match when you have so many orders—don’t worry. I can give you the warehouse arrival time, weight and sender location of this parcel. You can cross-check with your orders to find a match. If you still can’t tell, just send all your recent undelivered orders and we’ll go through them one by one.
Note: the only channel is the official customer service window—never direct customers to private social accounts; screenshots are only collected through official channels.

About the compensation: If you selected the insurance option and paid the premium when placing the order, we will compensate you at the declared value you insured. If the parcel is uninsured, compensation will follow the maximum payout cap in our consolidation service agreement. We will calculate the exact amount after verifying your order.
If the customer says the payout is too low and asks for several times the value → I fully understand your point of view. I can’t comment on other companies’ policies. Our compensation standard follows the service agreement you agreed to when signing up, and front-line staff don’t have authority to change it. If you’re not satisfied with the offer, you can also negotiate with the merchant or escalate your request through consumer protection channels.
If the customer asks whether shipping fees or taxes are covered → We’re very sorry, but according to the service agreement, compensation only covers the actual amount paid for the item itself and any insured value. Shipping fees, taxes, packing fees and agency fees are not included in the payout scope. This is stated in our service terms, which you can find on our website.
If the customer wants to offset shipping fees or asks for coupons instead → We’re very sorry, but claims and shipping accounts are two separate financial systems. We cannot offset them directly or exchange compensation for coupons. The payout can only be issued by bank transfer. Thank you for your understanding.
If the customer doesn’t accept the payout and insists on the item or a reshipment → I totally get that you’d rather have the item—if it were me I wouldn’t want to wait again either. But we’re only the consolidation warehouse; we can’t contact the merchant for a replacement, and we can’t recover the lost parcel. Getting the compensation and reordering is the fastest solution. We will prioritize your new parcel.
If the customer says a previous claim was faster or paid more → Processing time and payout vary depending on whether the parcel was insured and the order value. I will handle your case as quickly and favorably as possible, so you won’t have to wait too long.
Note: compensation follows the service agreement and insured value only—never promise multiples, never invent clauses, never promise extra compensation.
Note: this step covers the plan only—do not collect account details; payment information comes in the next step.

Submit the order screenshot via our official customer service window. Once approved, you provide your payment account details—bank transfer or Alipay are both fine. Since we’re a different company from your shopping platform, we can’t refund back to your original payment account; we can only send you a transfer.
If the customer asks when the money will arrive and wants a definite timeline → The standard process takes X working days for payment to arrive. I will flag your case as urgent and try to get it down to X working days. You will get an automated SMS notification once payment is sent, and you can also check progress anytime via official customer service. I will also follow up for you and let you know as soon as there’s an update.
If the customer finds the process too complicated and troublesome → I totally get that it feels like a lot of steps. The process is there to make sure every claim is accurate and to protect your payment security—mistakes would take even longer to fix. You only need to send the screenshot and account details once. The rest is our internal process; no more action needed from you.
If the customer asks whether you can pay part of it first → We’re very sorry, but our finance process requires full order verification before payment can be issued. We cannot make partial payments. I will push the review team to speed up the whole process as much as possible.
Note: state the timeline as “within X working days”—never promise same-day payment.

Please don’t worry—whatever you’re not happy with, just tell me directly. I will record your request and feedback and escalate it to my supervisor; you can also call our official complaints hotline for faster handling.
If the customer gets angry and asks for a supervisor or wants to complain → We’re very sorry to have made you so upset—this is our fault. I will immediately record your demands and complaint and escalate them to my supervisor. A dedicated staff member will contact you proactively within X working days. You can also call our official complaints hotline directly for faster handling.
If the customer says they will go to the merchant or the platform → That’s completely fine—go with whatever is easier for you. You have every right to do so. If the merchant or platform needs a loss confirmation letter or our cooperation in an investigation, we will fully cooperate. If you later decide to go through our claim process instead, that’s also fine anytime.
If the customer threatens to expose this or report to the regulators → We’re very sorry to have let you down. You have every right to provide feedback through any channel. We would much prefer to resolve the issue directly with you. Could you tell us specifically how you would like this handled? We will do our best to accommodate you within our compliance rules.
Note: never deny the customer’s right to approach the merchant, platform or regulators; never obstruct and never respond adversarially.

Great. I will text you the ticket number shortly. Quote it to official customer service and they can assist you. Please submit the screenshot when you can; we will review immediately upon receipt. Thank you for your understanding. Goodbye.
If the customer says they will think about it and decide later → No problem, take your time. I will keep your ticket open for X days; you can proceed anytime. If you have questions, just call official customer service and ask for me. Have a nice day. Goodbye.
Note: closing only confirms the ticket and how to proceed—no new promises.
